name: Decorative gradients and glow
summary: Use matte flat surfaces; drop gradients, glows and gradient text unless they encode data or a brand asset.
problem: Multi-colour gradients, outer glows and gradient text are a generic signal of generated UI. They conflict with the matte, restrained language and age quickly.

bad.description: A hero with a violet to green gradient, a glow around the card, gradient text and a glowing button.

good.title: Matte surface
good.description: A flat elevated surface, a clear title and one primary button.

why: Flat surfaces keep the product consistent and keep attention on content and the primary action.
exceptions: Gradients that encode data (heatmaps, scales) are allowed.
Skeleton shimmer and subtle scrims for text legibility on imagery are allowed.
A brand illustration or marketing asset that the brand explicitly specifies is allowed.

humanReview: Does the gradient or glow encode anything?
